sources.title: Consecutive frog gastrocnemius contraction tracings showing fatigue
sources.attribution: John Gray McKendrick, Life in Motion, or, Muscle and Nerve (1892), Fig. 66; drawing credits É.-J. Marey.
sources.known_calibration: The figure caption identifies a 100 vibrations/second chronograph; full amplitude calibration is not specified.
sources.caveats: Historical printed drawing; not calibrated force data or a machine-readable waveform. Verify directions of plotting before any digitization.
sources.image_label: Historical diagram of successive frog gastrocnemius contractions attributed to Marey; from McKendrick (1892). Numeric force scale unavailable.

sources.title: Kymographic frog-heart response to adrenaline
sources.attribution: Sachinthonakkara (2013), Frog heart kymographic recording, Wikimedia Commons.
sources.known_calibration: Image scan resolution is not a physiological calibration; numeric time/force scale not established.
sources.caveats: Study caption says first contraction is normal and adrenaline was infused. Verify cardiac mechanics/polarity experimentally. Derivatives must comply with ShareAlike.
sources.image_label: Original historical frog-heart kymographic scan: Wikimedia Commons, Sachinthonakkara, CC BY-SA 4.0. Numerical times/force unverified.

sources.title: Squid giant axon membrane potential and stimulus current
sources.species: Doryteuthis pealeii (source also uses Loligo pealei)
sources.attribution: Paydarfar D, Forger DB, Clay JR. J Neurophysiol. 2006;96:3338-3348; PhysioNet SGAMP v1.0.0 (2016).
sources.known_calibration: Raw PhysioNet record channels are in volts. Membrane potential: multiply raw volts by 0.1 to remove gain, then by 1000 for mV. Stimulus current: raw volts × 5 for µA/cm². Sampling 125 kHz; verify per-record header and instrumentation DC-offset before teaching.
sources.caveats: 170 records across eight axons; raw record not included here, calibration has not yet been applied or numerically validated by OPL.

sources.title: Continuous blood pressure in salt-sensitive Dahl rats
sources.attribution: Bugenhagen SM, Cowley AW Jr, Beard DA. Physiol Genomics. 2010;42:23-41; PhysioNet bpssrat (2012).
sources.known_calibration: Read the included text-file comments or WFDB headers for each rat; not independently validated.
sources.caveats: PhysioNet page also says freely distributed for noncommercial education/research despite ODC-BY label. Do not republish until terms clarified.

sources.title: Macaque anterior-insular cortex Patch-seq recordings
sources.attribution: DANDI: Electrophysiological Dataset of Patch-seq Recording in non-Human Primate Anterior Insular Cortex, version 0.260825.0222 (2026).
sources.known_calibration: NWB current-clamp metadata; do not assume sample rate or gain without inspecting selected NWB file.
sources.caveats: 14.7 GB total source; do not bulk mirror; fetch one small well-annotated file for pilot.

sources.title: The Virtual Frog: digitized recordings from 1992 undergraduate classes
sources.attribution: Bagust J, Bagust K, Brown I, Foreman R. Proc Physiol Soc. 2008;11:PC48.
sources.known_calibration: The abstract describes digitized real recordings; no original files obtained by OPL.
sources.caveats: High-priority request to authors for dataset and teaching reuse; not a source we can currently redistribute.

sources.title: Original rabbit jejunum concentration-response trace (Artemisia campestris)
sources.attribution: Myorelaxant and antispasmodic effect of aqueous Artemisia campestris extract; original Fig. 1A (2021).
sources.known_calibration: Graph includes dose information; exact time and force calibration not verified for OPL.
sources.caveats: Do not mirror/redraw a published figure before licensing/permission and scale verification.

sources.title: Frog-heart kymograph: adrenaline and lead acetate
sources.image_label: Original kymograph attributed to Sachinthonakkara (2017), CC BY-SA 4.0; frog heart receiving adrenaline and lead acetate. No verified force/time calibration.
sources.attribution: Sachinthonakkara (2017), Frog Heart Kymograph, Wikimedia Commons.
sources.known_calibration: Reported digital image pixels are not physiological units. No independent verification of experimental time or force scale.
sources.caveats: Drug order and concentrations cannot be inferred from trace alone. No digital waveform reconstructed.
